Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in a cationic chain-anchored monolayer that creates single-ion-like, solvent-phobic transport channels in composite polymer electrolytes. This yields low activation energy (0.092 eV) and high Li⁺ transference (0.78), enabling stable cycling from −25 to 120 °C. It offers a significant strategy for wide-temperature solid-state lithium-metal batteries.

ACS Energy Letters | 💭 Perspective | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This Perspective introduces a four-dimensional framework—objective, basis, scale, and process coupling—to classify modeling of polymer-based electrolytes. Using ionogels and composite electrodes, it exposes gaps in material-state definition, experiment-model transfer, structural representation, and process coupling. Its significance lies in advocating transparent, experimentally anchored workflows linking formulation, processing, structure, transport, and performance, rather than isolated models.

item.title: Adaptive Electrochemical Self‐Cleaning via Surface Reconstruction Enables Fluoride‐Free and Batch‐Consistent Cathode Regeneration
item.description:
یک راهبرد خودتمیزکاری الکتروشیمیایی با بازسازی سطح، حذف آلاینده‌های فلوئوره و بازیافت مستقیم کاتد NMC532 را با ظرفیت ۱۴۵٫۱ mAh/g و یکنواختی بین‌دسته‌ای بالا ممکن می‌سازد.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces electrochemically driven self-cleaning for direct cathode recycling, using anodic surface reconstruction to eliminate fluorinated impurities without fluoride reagents. It achieves fluoride-free NMC532 regeneration with commercial-grade capacity and under 1.3% batch variation, far surpassing conventional recycling. The strategy is scalable and applicable across cathode chemistries, enabling impurity-free, high-performance battery material regeneration.
🏷 direct recycling · NMC532 cathode · fluoride removal · surface reconstruction · electrochemical self-cleaning

item.title: Solid‐Solution Reactions in Layer‐Structured Oxide Cathodes Driven by Local Disorder and Electron Delocalization
item.description:
یک اکسید لایه‌ای با بی‌نظمی موضعی و دوپینگ بور از طریق کوئنچ ساخته شد که با بی‌نظمی موضعی و جابه‌جایی الکترون، واکنش محلول جامد برگشت‌پذیر و پایدار در کاتد باتری یون پتاسیم ایجاد می‌کند.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces a quenching-assisted boron incorporation strategy that creates local disorder and electron delocalization in layered oxide cathodes. By stabilizing the transition metal framework and suppressing destructive phase transitions, it enables a reversible solid-solution reaction pathway, offering new theoretical insights for designing long-life, high-performance cathode materials.
🏷 layered oxide cathode · solid-solution reaction · local disorder · electron delocalization · potassium-ion battery
